summary.text: Steven Rodriguez is the Republican candidate for the Colorado House of Representatives, District 62, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which he faces incumbent Democrat Matthew Martinez.
He defeated Evans Gonzalez in the June 30, 2026 Republican primary.

paragraphs.text: Rodriguez previously sought the Republican nomination for the same seat in 2020 and lost the June 30, 2020 primary to Logan Taggart.
